frame_contract.title: 触觉界面
frame_contract.subject_cue: a programmable 40 by 40 pin surface carrying decaying waves
frame_contract.governing_rule: A bounded trail of spatial impulses propagates damped radial waves through a height-displaced instanced pin field.
frame_contract.visible_consequence: Pin height, blue highlight, shadow depth, and camera response reveal the age, distance, and amplitude of each impulse.
frame_contract.title_safe_region: the full-width typographic overlay, with the main title in the upper-left and the claim across the middle-right
frame_contract.representative_normal_state: two deterministic auto waves followed by a pointer wave
frame_contract.representative_reduced_state: two seeded trail points at age 0.55 with no live loop

candidate.chassis_vendor_and_media: independent staging copies created before handoff; recursively byte-identical to the formal archive

author_layer.counting_rule: wc -m over author-owned runtime HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; UTF-8 decoded characters including newlines
excluded: assets/lib vendor bundle collection and chassis utilities
GSAP, Inter fonts, arrow.svg, and all license files
SOURCE.md, THIRD_PARTY.md, tests, screenshots, manifests, and this report
author_layer.tradeoff: The shorter baseline achieved 9460 characters by embedding compressed CSS, one-letter JavaScript, and compressed GLSL in an almost single-line HTML file. The candidate pays a deliberate readability cost for semantic HTML, a separate stylesheet, domain-named JavaScript, and fully expanded wave and postprocessing shaders. No minification or identifier mangling was used.

mini_decision.reason: The full version is above 10k after readability work; the original minified file being below 10k is not a valid no-mini exemption.

readability_changes: Split the compressed all-in-one page into semantic HTML, a focused stylesheet, and one ES module.
Named the fixed canvas, grid, trail capacity, seed, mutable simulation state, renderer stages, input paths, and teardown ownership.
Expanded the vertex wave algorithm into explicit sample position, radius, envelope, time fade, distance fade, weight, normalized height, and displacement steps.
Expanded height-based material color and vignette/chromatic-shift postprocessing shaders into readable GLSL without changing numerical operations.
Separated 40x40 instance construction, trail DataTexture upload, xorshift random sequence, pointer raycast, keyboard cursor, camera easing, render advance, resize, reset, and disposal.
Named each trail record's age and amplitude channels instead of retaining the baseline's opaque a/d property names.
Added a WebGL-construction failure branch that leaves the complete semantic title visible and exposes a stable empty state instead of an uncaught module failure.
Kept all source lines within 140 columns after the GLSL rewrite; the candidate is readable source rather than pretty-printed minification.

postprocessing: custom vignette and RGB shift ShaderPass
inputs: pointermove raycast to the y=0 plane
motion_and_lifecycle: GSAP title duration 1s, stagger 0.1s, power3.out, delay 0.5s

fixed_state_equivalence.method: Replace Deck.loop in the test response with a captured frame callback, reset to the canonical state, drive identical deltas and real inputs, freeze the title at its completed state, suppress incidental pointer events during viewport transitions, and wait for both Deck scale and the actual stage bounds before capture.

font_raster_repeatability_note.observation: One full-matrix run produced the same 713-pixel glyph-raster variation inside the SHAPE DISPLAY footer that had also appeared between two baseline states after viewport cycling.
font_raster_repeatability_note.scope: Only the 124x13 footer glyph bounding box; WebGL and layout pixels were unchanged.
font_raster_repeatability_note.verification: Two fresh baseline-candidate normal-initial matched pairs were each AE=0; baseline self-repeat and candidate self-repeat were also AE=0. The stored normal-initial pair was recaptured in fresh contexts and is AE=0.
font_raster_repeatability_note.interpretation: Chromium font rasterization after viewport cycling, not candidate code; arbitrary unrelated captures are not claimed bit-identical.

independent_findings: The first report treated composer.dispose() as complete postprocessing cleanup, but EffectComposer only releases its render targets and internal copy pass; the authored ShaderPass and OutputPass still owned undisposed GPU materials/fullscreen quads.
The primary destroy path left window.__TACTILE__ pointing at closures over the disposed renderer, scene, mesh, textures and trail state, and manual destroy left the pagehide listener registered.

The original fixed-state harness stored screenshots without asserting their hashes and could read DOM geometry after Deck.s changed but before the stage transform committed, causing an intermittent reduced-touch state mismatch.
Trail records still used a/d property names despite the report's domain-naming claim.
staging_fixes: Retained explicit references to the tactile ShaderPass and OutputPass and disposed both exactly once before composer and renderer teardown.
Removed the owned pagehide listener and public API reference on both primary and WebGL-fallback teardown paths while keeping a held stale handle idempotent and inert for verification.
Renamed trail record channels to age and amplitude without changing Float32 DataTexture channel order, values or shader input.

Made viewport capture wait for actual stage bounds, disabled incidental Canvas pointer targeting only during resizing/capture, reset every mode to its canonical state, and asserted both semantic-state and PNG SHA256 for every pair.
